name: @w6w-apps/google-tasks
description: Read and manage Google Tasks: task lists, tasks, completion, reordering, and clearing completed work.

w6w.longDescription:
Google Tasks puts a user's own task lists and tasks into a workflow — list, create, update and delete task lists; create, update, complete, reorder and delete tasks; and clear out everything already completed in a list. Every write goes through a partial update rather than a full replace, so setting one field never silently clears the others.

The app follows the API's own quirks rather than papering over them: completing a task is a status change, not a separate endpoint, and reopening one just sets the status back; clearing completed tasks hides them rather than deleting them, so they keep their ids and can still be found later with the right flag; and a due date only ever carries a date, never a time of day, because that is all Google's Tasks API stores.

Authentication is OAuth2 with the single write-capable tasks scope — there is no service-account path, since Tasks data belongs to a person and a service account has no task list of its own to act on.
